newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, seen weak on NOC demand.
newsitem.headline: Nepal rupee steady vs dlr, seen weak on NOC demand.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened at 56.93/56.95 per dollar on Thursday, little changed from the previous close, dealers said.
"There could be short term pressure and the rates could go up in view of large dollar demand from state-owned Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC)," one dealer said.
"NOC needs $7.7 million for the import of petroleum products, which is due for payment on Sunday," he said.
The pressure is unlikely to be felt soon, as there is a continous inflow of dollar in the market to cope up with existing demand, dealers said.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rate at 56.75/57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 7.50-8.00 percent on Thursday, unchanged from the previous close, dealers said.
